name: design-file-finder
title: Creativity Files Finder
description: Search, sort by recency, and launch creative project files (.prproj, .psd, .psb, .ai, .aep) across mounted drives.
author: yusoufu

commands.name: search-design-files
commands.title: Search Creativity Files
commands.description: Find Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects files across your drives.

commands.name: new-from-template
commands.title: New from Template
commands.description: Create a new Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, or Premiere file from a template.

preferences.name: templatesFolder
preferences.title: Templates Folder
preferences.description: Folder of starter .psd/.ai/.aep/.prproj files. Searched recursively.

preferences.name: defaultDestination
preferences.title: Default Destination
preferences.description: Optional default folder where new projects are created.

preferences.name: enrichRecency
preferences.title: Last-opened dates
preferences.label: Use Spotlight "last opened" on indexed drives
preferences.description: Enriches sorting with the real last-opened date on indexed drives. Falls back to modified time when off or unavailable.

preferences.name: hideAutoSaves
preferences.title: Auto-save files
preferences.label: Hide Adobe auto-save backups
preferences.description: Filters out files inside "Auto-Save" folders (Premiere/After Effects backup churn) so the real projects surface.
